title: A Shopping Trip
text:
Maria wrote a shopping list before she went to the supermarket. She needed milk, bread, eggs, and two apples. She also wanted some rice for dinner.

At the supermarket, Maria took a basket and found everything on her list. She paid for the food at the counter. Then she walked home with her heavy bags.

questions.text: What did Maria write before she went to the supermarket?
Where did Maria pay for the food?
Why was the list useful for Maria?
options: It helped her remember the things she needed
It was a gift for her friend
It showed the prices of the food
It was for a school project

questions.text: How did Maria probably feel when she got home?

vocabulary.definition: a set of written items that you want to remember or buy
a container used for carrying things
a flat table in a shop where you pay

paragraph_translations: Maria escreveu uma lista de compras antes de ir ao supermercado. Ela precisava de leite, pão, ovos e duas maçãs. Ela também queria um pouco de arroz para o jantar.
No supermercado, Maria pegou uma cesta e encontrou tudo o que estava na lista. Ela pagou a comida no balcão. Depois, voltou para casa com as sacolas pesadas.
